column3: MT 21:11. Close to the Hebrew; “with breaking of loins” is rendered “with a breaking heart.”
MT 21:14. Close to the Hebrew; “the Lord” (Adonai) is rendered “the LORD.”
MT 21:15. The second half of the verse is obscure in Hebrew; the meaning is uncertain. NKJV capitalizes “My Son” in “the scepter of My Son.”
MT 21:16. Close to the Hebrew; the indefinite “one gave it” is capitalized as “He has given it.”
MT 21:18. The Hebrew of this verse is obscure; the meaning is uncertain.
MT 21:19. Close to the Hebrew, but the last line is obscure and the meaning is uncertain; NKJV renders “That enters their private chambers.”
MT 21:20. Close to the Hebrew; the rare word rendered “the point of the sword” is of uncertain meaning.
MT 21:21. The Hebrew of this verse is terse and obscure; the meaning is uncertain. NKJV renders it as commands to the sword.
MT 21:26. Close to the Hebrew; the teraphim are rendered “the images.”
MT 21:32. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV capitalizes “He” and “Him” in “Until He comes whose right it is,” reading the verse messianically.
MT 21:33. Close to the Hebrew; the word rendered “For consuming” is of uncertain meaning.
